covers: concurrent writes from two store instances serialize; same request key commits once
held row lock: write fails at lock_timeout (~4 s) through the pooler, then recovers
backend terminated while the financial callback awaits: no commit, no replay, same process recovers
V2.0.0 row-version query: unchanged row returns no ledger body; stale version returns the full row
a commit by another instance is visible to the next read and to the next locked write
NUL and an emoji cut by the length limit are normalized and commit (V1.0.3: 503 BANK_STORE_UNAVAILABLE, causes 22P05 / 22P02)
database restart changes the row version (xmin unchanged, server start time changed); the store reconnects
